partners.name: Your approved bank connection
partners.reason: Keep existing bank settlement and account authority. Bind each account, currency and provider to an explicit connection before enabling execution.
partners.condition: A synthetic account is supplied for each test currency. No live bank adapter or account is configured.

partners.name: Native USDC connection
partners.reason: Keep token identity, signing authority and chain evidence explicit. Read-only indexing never proves a payout or authorizes a transaction.
partners.condition: The included asset is Base Sepolia test USDC. Production network, asset, signer and finality require separate configuration.

partners.name: Approved issuer program
partners.reason: Evaluate branded issuance separately from payment recovery. Assign legal issuer, reserve custody, redemption rights and control ownership.
partners.condition: Issuer lab is synthetic only. No redeemable issuance or provider relationship is enabled.
required_binding: reserve custody and full balance attestations
